question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a silver present, Bob has a red present, and Claire has a purple present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) silver present
(B) red present
(C) purple present
solution:
Gift colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: silver, red, purple
1. Claire ↔ Alice: purple, red, silver
2. Alice ↔ Claire: silver, red, purple
3. Alice ↔ Claire: purple, red, silver
Bob has the red present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
